paite: Ka naute aw, thil na hihkhelhlouhna ding un hiai thute na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelhleh Pa kiang a hon gensakpa, Jesu Khrist, midiktat i nei hi.
heading: Gensakpa Jesu Khrist
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

paite: Amah i khelhnate thuphatawina ahi, eimah khelhna kia hilou in, khovel tengteng khelhna thuphatawina leng ahi.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

paite: Huan athupiakte i zuihleh huai ah amah i thei chih i kithei hi.
heading: Pathian Theihna Athupiakte Zuih Ahi
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

paite: Athupiakte zui lou a, "Amah ka thei," chimi zaw mizuauthei ahi, amah ah thutak a-om kei hi.
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

paite: Kuapeuh athu zui peuhmah amah ah Pathian itna akim petmah hi. Amah ah i om chih hiai ah i kithei ahi.
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

paite: Amah ah ka om gige chimi, amah om bang in a-om sam ding ahi.
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

paite: Deihtakte aw, thupiak thak na kiang uah ka gelh kei a; thupiak lui atung a kipan a na neih uh ka gelh zaw ahi. Huai thupiak lui na thu theihsa pen uh ahi.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

paite: Himahleh thupiak thak gelh hi sam na veng, huai amah ah leh noumau ah alang hi, mial aman lellel ziak in leh vak taktak tua ahong vak tak ziak in.
english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

paite: A-unau ho napi a, vak ah ka om chimi tutan in leng mial ah a-om gige hi.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

paite: A-unau itmi bel vak ah a-om gige a, amah ah kipalpaihna ding san a-om kei hi.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

paite: A-unau homi zaw mial ah a-om a, mial ah akhosa a, mial in amit atotsak ziak in apaina leng athei kei hi.
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

paite: Naute aw, ama min ziak a na khelhnate uh ngaihdam ahih tak ziak in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
heading: Khrist Theite Hinkhua
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

paite: Pate aw, amah atung a kipan a om gige na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Tangvalte aw, Pathian thu noumau ah a-om gige a, giloupa na zoh tak ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Naute aw, Pa na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

paite: Pate aw, amah atung a kipan a om gige na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Tangvalte aw, na hat ua Pathian thu noumau ah a-om gige a, migilou na zoh tak ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

paite: Khovel it kei unla, khovel a thil omte leng it sam kei un. Mi kuapeuh in khovel a-itleh Pa itna amah ah a-om kei hi.
heading: Khovel It Kei Un
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

paite: Khovel a thil om tengteng, taksa utnate, mit utnate, damsung thupina limte Pa a kipan ahi kei a, khovel a kipan ahi zaw hi.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

paite: Khovel, a-utnate toh amangthang lellel ahi. Pathian deihlam hihmi bel tangtawn in a-om gige ding hi.
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

paite: Naute aw, hun nanungpen hita e, Khrist doupa ahong pai ding chih na zak bang un tu in leng Khrist doumi tampitak ahong pawtta uhi; huaiziak in hun nanungpen ahita chih i thei uhi.
heading: Khrist Doudalpa
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

paite: Amaute i lak ua kipan in apawt ua, himahleh ei sung mi tak ahi kei uh; ei sung mi tak hi le uh i kiang uah a-om sam ding uhi; himahleh avek un ei sung mi tak ahi kei uh chih alatchetna ding in ahon pawtsanta uhi.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

paite: Mi Siangthou kiang a kipan thaunilhna na tang ua, bangkim na thei uhi.
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

paite: Thutak na theih louh ziak ua ka gelh ahi kei a, na theih ziak uh leh thutak a zuau bangmah apawt ngei louh ziak in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

paite: Jesu tuh Khrist ahi chih gingtaloumi sang a zuauthei kua a-om a? Khrist doumi tuh Pa leh Tapa gingtaloumi ahi.
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

paite: Kuapeuh Tapa nial in Pa anei kei a; kuapeuh Tapa gingta in bel Pa leng asang hi.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

paite: Nou zaw atung a kipan a na zak uh noumau ah omsak gige un. Huai atung a kipan a na zak uh noumau a a-om gigeleh noute ngei leng Tapa leh Pa ah na om gige ding uhi.
heading: Thutak Nei Gige
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

paite: Hiai ahi amah ngei in ahon chiam pen: tangtawn hinna.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

paite: Noumau hon pimang tumte tungtang na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

paite: Nou zaw amah kiang a kipan a thaunilhna na tan uh noumau ah a-om gige a, kuamah hilh na kiphamoh kei uhi; ama thaunilhna in thil tengteng ahon sinsak bang in leh hiai thudik hi a, zuau leng ahih louh ziak in huai in nou ahon sinsak bang in amah ah om gige un.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

paite: Huchi in naute aw, amah ah om gige un; amah ahong kilak chiang in ama ah zum lou in hangsantak in i om thei ding uhi.
heading: Pathian Tate Diktatna
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

paite: Amah midiktat ahi chih na theih uleh mi kuapeuh diktatna hihmi amah a suak ahi chih na thei uhi.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
